data.title: Landing: lead with use cases, after the first outside review
data.description: A developer who uses coding agents reviewed kadence.guru cold, on a screen recording (5:53). They understood 'shared context' but not how an agent uses it; asked whether the journal is compacted or embedded when it outgrows the context window; did not feel the pain, because their agent already remembers yesterday; read the decision terminal as 'a shell command for every decision'; and found the page 'a lot of dense code snippets'. Their recommendation: name the use cases and everyday problems first. Rewritten in kadence-site: hero, four use cases with who it is not for, what an agent actually reads, under the hood, cost, honest. Every capture is real output from this repository.
